svg.title: One chunk at a time, from the image group to the label group
svg.desc: One OME-Zarr store holds two groups: on the left the input group /image with its chunk files (purple), on the right the output group /label with empty slots (green). The worker reads one chunk at a time into its small memory box, processes it (the chunk turns orange, then green), writes the result chunk into the matching slot of /label and lets the chunk go. Each processed chunk also leaves a tiny per-chunk results table that stacks up beside the memory box. After the last chunk the small tables move to the right edge and merge, row by row, into one assembled results table.
